research_name: Historical Fusion V3.2.1 Segment 1 - Weak-Side Safety and Favourite Fragility

scope.segment_goal: increase full-coverage and mismatch-regime Top1 without any degradation of actual weak-side-win conditional logloss
scope.overall_55_target: reserved for later fully integrated V3.2.1; this segment alone is not permitted to claim 55 percent confirmation

frozen_dynamic_state.source: V3.2 pre-frozen dynamic-state family, now fixed rather than reselected
frozen_dynamic_state.pit_rule: only completed lagged Understat event history available before each target kickoff

regime_definition.favourite_side: argmax of frozen V3.1.1 P(Home) versus P(Away); draw never defines favourite side
regime_definition.continuous_mismatch_weight: reuse frozen V3.2 fragility_weight(abs(dynamic_strength_gap / dynamic_gap_sd)); no new hard strong-weak threshold

candidate_A_draw_only_fragility.name: Exact Weak-Side Preservation + Favourite-vs-Draw Conditional Repair
candidate_A_draw_only_fragility.structural_constraint: P_weak_after == P_weak_frozen_V3_1_1 to machine tolerance on every eligible match
candidate_A_draw_only_fragility.conditional_model: ridge binary logistic residual for Draw versus Favourite among training outcomes that are Draw or Favourite, with frozen V3.1.1 conditional odds as offset
candidate_A_draw_only_fragility.feature_orientation: all directional dynamic features are oriented favourite-minus-weak; no outcome-known features
candidate_A_draw_only_fragility.prediction_rule: weak probability fixed exactly; only remaining mass is redistributed between favourite and draw; shift is continuous and capped

candidate_B_independent_upset_gate.name: Candidate A + One-Sided Weak-Uplift Evidence Gate
candidate_B_independent_upset_gate.upset_model: ridge binary logistic residual for WeakWin versus NotWeakWin with frozen V3.1.1 weak-win odds as offset
candidate_B_independent_upset_gate.independence_rule: upset residual uses weak-side-oriented dynamic/process features and may not use the favourite-vs-draw fitted residual or the actual target outcome at prediction time
candidate_B_independent_upset_gate.one_sided_rule: P_weak may only increase above candidate A / frozen baseline; negative or zero residual produces zero weak-side change
candidate_B_independent_upset_gate.mass_source: weak-side uplift mass is taken from favourite probability only; draw probability from candidate A is preserved unless favourite mass is insufficient
candidate_B_independent_upset_gate.structural_safety: actual weak-side-win conditional logloss cannot worsen versus frozen V3.1.1 because P_weak_after >= P_weak_baseline on every match

selection_protocol.2018: fit candidate models only using frozen-base genuine OOS predictions after the existing burn-in procedure
selection_protocol.2019: mechanically enumerate only the frozen grids in this contract; each family selects highest full-coverage Top1 among settings passing all 2019 hard gates; tie lower logloss then Brier then deterministic parameter tuple
selection_protocol.2020_2022: expanding-history rolling OOS with 2019-selected hyperparameters; candidate family must pass all pooled hard gates and at least 6 of 8 existing chronological fold nondegradation gates
selection_protocol.family_selection: among nontrivial A/B families passing all 2020-2022 hard gates select highest full-coverage Top1; tie higher mismatch-regime Top1 then lower global logloss then family_id
selection_protocol.2023: candidate-fixed POST_VIEW diagnostic only; no change after read
